$comment: Who may read which zone of examples/corpus. Read beside corpus.acl.json: that file says which
group owns a document, this one says which principals are in that group.
prn_alice is the interesting one. She is engineering, so the finance documents are present in
the corpus, adjacent in vocabulary to the ones she may read, and forbidden to her — which is
what makes a leak count over this corpus evidence rather than arithmetic. Nobody but prn_exec
may read the restricted zone, and prn_exec exists so that the hidden document is reachable by
somebody; a document no principal can read is not a test of anything.
A principal named here but absent from a group still resolves — to a smaller set. A principal
absent from this file does not resolve at all, and the request fails closed (PRD 9.4).
